summary: Consumers Energy Company filed an 8-K to report the issuance and sale of $850 million aggregate principal amount of 5.125% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036, pursuant to a shelf registration statement. The offering was conducted through an underwriting agreement with BNP Paribas, J.P. Morgan, and others. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event, as it involves an ordinary takedown from an existing shelf registration with no change of control, restructuring, or strategic shift.
